title: Stringmaster
statementMd:
After years of training, you have finally awakened your true power and become a stringmaster, allowing you to perform the following operation on a string:

Choose a subsequence$^{\text{∗}}$ that is a palindrome$^{\text{†}}$ and arbitrarily permute the characters at the selected positions.

Here is an example of such an operation where we select the palindrome `tst`: $$ \mathtt{{\color{red}t}e{\color{red}{st}}ing} \;\to\; \mathtt{{\color{red}s}e{\color{red}{tt}}ing} $$

Now you have a string $x$, and you want to know if you can turn it into a string $y$ by performing the above operation any number of times (possibly zero).

$^{\text{∗}}$A string $a$ is a subsequence of a string $b$ if a can be obtained from $b$ by the deletion of several (possibly zero or all) characters.

$^{\text{†}}$A string is called a palindrome if it is the same when written in reverse order. For example, `eertree` and `abba` are palindromes.

## Input

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $t$ ($1 \le t \le 10^4$). The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the length of the strings $x$ and $y$.

The second line of each test case contains a string $x$ of length $n$ consisting of lowercase Latin letters.

The third line of each test case contains a string $y$ of length $n$ consisting of lowercase Latin letters.

It is guaranteed that the sum of $n$ over all test cases does not exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

## Output

For each test case, output `YES` if you can turn $x$ into $y$, and `NO` otherwise.

You can output `YES` and `NO` in any case (for example, `yES`, `yes`, and `Yes` will be accepted).

## Note

The solution to the first test case is shown above.

In the second test case, it is not possible to change the string.

In the third test case, no operations are needed.
statementZhMd:
经过多年的训练，你终于觉醒了真正的力量，成为了一名字符串大师，可以对字符串执行以下操作：

选择一个为回文串$^{\text{†}}$的子序列$^{\text{∗}}$，并任意重排所选位置上的字符。

下面是选择回文串 `tst` 进行操作的一个例子：$$ \mathtt{{\color{red}t}e{\color{red}{st}}ing} \;\to\; \mathtt{{\color{red}s}e{\color{red}{tt}}ing} $$

现在你有一个字符串 $x$，你想知道能否执行任意次上述操作（可以为零次），将其变成字符串 $y$。

$^{\text{∗}}$如果字符串 $a$ 可以通过从字符串 $b$ 中删除若干个字符（可以不删除，也可以全部删除）得到，则称 $a$ 是 $b$ 的子序列。

$^{\text{†}}$如果一个字符串反向书写后与原字符串相同，则称其为回文串。例如，`eertree` 和 `abba` 都是回文串。

## 输入格式

每个测试包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $t$（$1 \le t \le 10^4$）。接下来是各组测试用例的描述。

每组测试用例的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$）——字符串 $x$ 和 $y$ 的长度。

每组测试用例的第二行包含一个长度为 $n$、仅由小写拉丁字母组成的字符串 $x$。

每组测试用例的第三行包含一个长度为 $n$、仅由小写拉丁字母组成的字符串 $y$。

保证所有测试用例的 $n$ 之和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

## 输出格式

对于每组测试用例，如果可以将 $x$ 变成 $y$，输出 `YES`，否则输出 `NO`。

输出 `YES` 和 `NO` 时，字母大小写任意（例如，`yES`、`yes` 和 `Yes` 都会被接受）。

## 说明

第一组测试用例的方案如上所示。

在第二组测试用例中，无法改变字符串。

在第三组测试用例中，无需进行任何操作。
